replaces.description: stock:mappoint/<n>: the map point this planet takes over (an in-place edit). Without it the planet gets a point of its own (the port's planet registry: disc and routes)

fixedWorld.description: phase 0 only: the world number until the port's planet registry exists

index.description: take-over: the map disc to edit (8-10 are moons in the stock map); a point of its own: the stock disc whose textures it wears

colour.description: a point of its own: the colour of its top layer

galaxy.description: a galaxy of this project (galaxies/<name>.json); none = the game's own galaxy

unlock.description: when the planet shows: start (from the beginning), stock (once the stock map point its route leaves from is open: the game's galaxy's default), script (when a trigger or script opens it), or once another planet of the project was entered / completed

oneOf.description: take-overs: heroes it opens for at a new game (not carried out by the port yet)

from.description: stock:mappoint/<n> (the game's galaxy) or pack:world/<planet> (another planet of the same galaxy)

entryLevel.description: where each hero starts the planet from the map: pack:level/<name> (a level of the project) or stock:level/<n>
